notes: Quality evals: run each prompt twice — with skill forced (read SKILL.md + needed reference/) and without skill (no skill files). Grade binary assertions. Trigger evals live in trigger.json.

modes.description: Force-load skill: read SKILL.md and only needed reference/* before answering.
General knowledge only; do not read .agents/skills/oapi-codegen-best-practices.

evals.prompt: Greenfield Go service: OpenAPI 3 for a pets API. Recommend oapi-codegen (v2) generate config for Gin, how to implement handlers, and how to wire request validation + Bearer auth. Keep it concrete (YAML + Go sketches).
evals.expected_output: YAML with models, gin-server, strict-server, embedded-spec; StrictServerInterface + NewStrictHandler + RegisterHandlers; gin-middleware with GetSwagger, Servers cleared, AuthenticationFunc for Bearer.
assertions: Uses github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2 (not deepmap) or equivalent current module path.
Generate config enables gin-server, strict-server, models, and embedded-spec (or clearly equivalent).
Does not enable chi-server together with gin-server in the same generate block.
Handlers implement StrictServerInterface (or clearly describe wrapping NewStrictHandler).
Uses github.com/oapi-codegen/gin-middleware (or correct gin validation middleware) for request validation.
Clears or disables OpenAPI Servers host matching (e.g. swagger.Servers = nil) or explains why not.
Auth is enforced via middleware AuthenticationFunc (or openapi3filter Options), not only per-handler checks.

evals.prompt: Same pets API but the team standardizes on Chi, not Gin. Give the oapi-codegen config differences and the router wiring, including validation middleware package choice.
evals.expected_output: chi-server + strict + models + embedded-spec; HandlerFromMux/HandlerWithOptions; nethttp-middleware; same strict handler signatures as Gin.
assertions: Generate config uses chi-server: true (not gin-server).
Registration uses HandlerFromMux or HandlerWithOptions.
Validation middleware is github.com/oapi-codegen/nethttp-middleware (or clearly net/http-compatible oapi middleware).
States that strict handler signatures are framework-agnostic / same as Gin strict.

evals.prompt: Production API returns HTTP 400 with message like 'no matching operation was found' for requests that look valid. Spec has servers with production URLs. App is behind a reverse proxy. Diagnose and fix for an oapi-codegen + validation middleware setup.
evals.expected_output: Blame Servers/host validation and/or BaseURL mount mismatch; recommend clearing Servers and aligning path prefixes.
assertions: Identifies OpenAPI Servers / Host validation as a likely cause.
Recommends clearing swagger.Servers (or equivalent) when reverse-proxy Host should not be validated against spec servers.
Mentions mount path / BaseURL / path prefix mismatch as another common cause.
Does not recommend disabling all validation middleware as the primary fix.

evals.prompt: StrictServerInterface handler for GET /users/{id}. Domain service returns domain.ErrNotFound or a DB error. How should the handler return 404 vs 500? Show the Go pattern.
evals.expected_output: 404 via typed *404JSONResponse with nil error; unexpected errors returned as (nil, err) for ResponseErrorHandlerFunc.
assertions: Maps expected not-found to a typed 404 response object with error == nil.
Returns unexpected errors as (nil, err) (or equivalent) leading to 500 via ResponseErrorHandlerFunc.
Does not recommend writing directly to http.ResponseWriter inside a strict handler as the main pattern.
Does not recommend using bare error return for documented 404 business outcomes.

evals.prompt: Review this plan: hand-edit server.gen.go to rename a type; skip committing generated files; rely on c.ShouldBindJSON in Gin after enabling strict-server; re-enable compatibility.enable-auth-scopes-on-context for new auth. What is wrong?
evals.expected_output: Rejects hand-editing gen, not committing gen, double-bind under strict, and deprecated scopes-on-context for new code.
assertions: Rejects hand-editing generated files; fix spec/config and regenerate instead.
Recommends committing generated code and/or CI drift checks.
Warns against double-binding the body when strict-server already unmarshals it.
Rejects enable-auth-scopes-on-context for new designs in favor of validation middleware AuthenticationFunc.

evals.prompt: Only rename an enum description in openapi.yaml for better docs. No paths or schemas change. Do I need oapi-codegen best practices / to regenerate server stubs?
evals.expected_output: Doc-only OpenAPI change; this skill's server wiring is out of scope; regenerate only if embedded-spec must match served docs.
assertions: Does not force a full Gin/Chi rewiring guide for a doc-only description change.
Points to OpenAPI writing guidance or treats it as spec documentation, not handler redesign.
If regeneration is mentioned, limits it to embedded-spec / served contract freshness rather than new handler architecture.
